messages:
nina: Nightly alert — rag nightly for legal_promptset (nightly-2026-03-19) shows topk@10 recall drop from 0.88 -> 0.81. CI/regression threshold breached. Anyone touch reranker/embeddings yesterday? :eyes:

eval-bot: [nightly-run] job=nightly-2026-03-19 dataset=legal_promptset metric=recall@10 old=0.880 new=0.810 delta=-0.070 severity=warning link=https://ci.internal/runs/2026-03-19/nb123

sam: I pushed a small reranker weight tweak around 2026-03-18 22:10 — lambda from 1.0 -> 1.15 (experimental). It shipped to staging and then promoted to nightly. Did we also onboard a new embedding?

mike: @sam yeah I rolled instructor-embed-v2-quant-8bit into the nightly candidate set around the same time (we were testing 8-bit quant for cost).

leo: Quick hypothesis: quantization introduced embedding drift that reduces nearest-neighbor recall, and reranker weight change amplified ranking mismatch. Both together could explain gap.

rachael: Reproduced locally on my dev VM against snapshot of the index: running the same eval command shows the drop. Command I ran:
```
./scripts/run_rag_eval --dataset=legal_promptset --topk=10 --emb_model=instructor-embed-v2-quant-8bit --reranker=pairwise-ltr --reranker-lambda=1.15 --index=snapshot-2026-03-18
```
Output snippet: recall@10 = 0.812 (was 0.879 with instructor-embed-v2-fp16 + lambda=1.0)

sam: Can you dump some NN distance distributions? want to see mean cosine shift pre/post.

dev-pratik: Quick dist compare (sample 2k queries):
- instructor-embed-v2-fp16 mean max_cosine = 0.72
- instructor-embed-v2-quant-8bit mean max_cosine = 0.66
- shift ~ -0.06, std slightly higher. Also top1/top5 hit rate dropped proportionally. Attaching histogram in a follow-up (will post link).

rachael: Also looked at false positives — more near-duplicates are bubbling to top with quantized vectors, so reranker lambda maybe promoting lexical signals that prefer wrong docs for this promptset.

nina: Important question: is this specific to legal_promptset (long documents, lots of boilerplate) or across datasets?

eval-bot: quick scan: other datasets (kb_small, customer_faqs) show tiny/no change; heavier-doc datasets (legal, contracts) show largest delta. Suggests doc-length / boilerplate interactions.

mike: Repro on dedicated infra (gpu-dedicated-3) gives same pattern. So not just host differences.

sam: Proposed quick mitigations:
1) rollback reranker lambda to 1.0 in nightly and rerun job
2) re-evaluate quantized embedding offline vs fp16 and consider 6-bit/asymmetric quant variants
3) add a per-dataset gating rule: block quantized embed onboarding for 'long-doc' tag datasets until we validate

rachael: Action: I'll start a rollback PR for nightly config (will pin lambda to 1.0) and queue a rerun. If rollback restores recall, we can isolate quantization as primary cause.

nina: Thanks. Also let's capture a small AB test: reindex ~10k docs with fp16 and quantized vectors and run per-query reranker scoring to see where reranker decisions diverge. Can someone create the job?

dev-pratik: I can spin that up today. I'll run pairwise diffs and export a CSV of queries where reranker changed top doc.

mike: One more note — autopromote pipeline mistakenly allowed quantized vectors into nightly without the per-dataset guard. Filing a bug in infra.

nina: Good catch. @mike please link the infra bug here once filed. Also label this incident as "rl/recall-regression-legal-2026-03-19" for tracking.

rachael: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/nightly-config/pull/987 (rollback reranker lambda) — queued.

sam: Running the rollback now, will post updated nightly metrics when job completes (~30m).

nina: Thanks everyone. Next check-in in 45m or when job finishes. :thumbsup:

(45m later)

sam: Update: rollback restored recall@10 to 0.879 on the re-run. Difference isolated to quantized embedding + elevated lambda combo.

nina: Conclusion: Block quantized embedding wide rollout for long-doc datasets, revert the lambda change for now. Follow-ups: 1) run AB diffs (dev-pratik) 2) evaluate alternative quant schemes (mike) 3) add gate in autopromote (sam/infra). I'll file a postmortem note after AB artifacts are in.

dev-pratik: AB diffs job started, exporting results to s3://redwood-evals/ab-diffs/2026-03-19-rag-quant-vs-fp16.csv

mike: Filed infra bug: https://infra.internal/bugs/5421 — autopromote didnt respect dataset-gating rules.

rachael: Putting a hold on onboarding ticket EMB-314 until we confirm quantization safety.

nina: Great work. Closing thread for now; will reopen after AB diffs land. :white_check_mark:
